title: Smiling Toddler Girl in Striped Swimsuit, 1960s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot capturing a candid portrait of a happy toddler girl standing in an outdoor backyard kiddie pool on a sunny summer day. She wears a striped one-piece swimsuit and has her hair tied up in a fountain topknot ponytail. Light and shade filter through leaves in the background against a house, evoking suburban American domestic life in the late 1960s.
